description:
Shin Eui-Jeong had been relieving the stress he faced at work and at home by partying hard at gay clubs. That day, Eui-Jeong went to the club to blow off some steam as usual, where he met Kwon Cha-Kyung, a man with the muscular build and handsome face he was looking for, but...

 *“You slut, you like this?”*

Oh, I picked a crazy son of a bitch...

What are the odds that a one-night stand is a thug who just got out of prison? Realizing that Cha-Kyung is a dangerous man, Eui-Jeong tries desperately to escape this danger, but it seems being the mistress of a thug just suits him...

(Source: MrBlue, translated)
